Iribhoni enye ijikeleza ibhokisi kanye ngomhlathi wobubanzi kwaye enye ijikeleza kanye ngomhlathi wobude. Ungacingi ngobukhulu beribhoni, kwaye usebenzise i-25 cm eyongezelelweyo yeqhina nokwenza ibhaso.

Ngoko i-180 cm kumgca 2 kunye ne-205 cm kumgca 3 ziphosakele nazo. Ukuhamba kanye kwicala lobubanzi yi-20+10+20+10=60 cm, ukuhamba kanye kwicala lobude yi-15+10+15+10=50 cm, ngoko 60+50+25=135 cm ichanekile.

z-m-14-01.title: Ukuya ngesantya se-60 km ngeyure nokubuya ngesantya se-40 km ngeyure: umndilili wohambo lokuya nokubuya yintoni?
z-m-14-01.topic: Umndilili wesantya sohambo lokuya nokubuya: xa imigama ifana nexa amaxesha efana
z-m-14-01.goal: Vavanya ngemizekelo yamanani ingcamango yokuqikelela isantya esiqhelekileyo sohambo lokuya nokubuya njenge 'ndawo ephakathi yezantya ezimbini,' uze uthi isiphumo sahluka njani xa ugcina umgama ufanayo nalapho ugcina ixesha lifanayo.
z-m-14-01.material: Intsapho ka-Mina yaya yabuya kwindlu kakhulu ngemoto kwindlela enye. Xa beya apho bakhwela ngesantya se-60 km ngeyure (isantya sokuhamba i-60 km ngeyure enye) ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ekupheleni, kwaye xa bebuya bakhwela ngesantya se-40 km ngeyure ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ekupheleni, ngaphandle kokuphumla phakathi. Umgama wohambo lokuya nolokubuya uyafana. Apha, 'isantya esiqhelekileyo sohambo lokuya nokubuya' sisantya ngeyure obuya kuba nosiso ukuba ubukhwela yonke indlela ukuya nokubuya ngesantya esifanayo ngalo lonke ixesha. Awukawazi ukuba umgama ungama-km angaphi.
z-m-14-01.thinking.0: Ukuvavanya uqikelelo lwakho lokuqala ngamanani athile
z-m-14-01.thinking.1: Ukuhlaziya isigwebo sakho nokuzithemba emva kokubona ulwazi olutsha
z-m-14-01.thinking.2: Ukutshintsha umgama ukubona ukuba isiphumo siyatshintsha na
z-m-14-01.thinking.3: Ukufumana imeko apho isiphumo sixhomekeke koko kugcinwe kufana
z-m-14-01.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yesantya: umgama ohanjiwe ngeyure enye (isantya ngeyure)
z-m-14-01.prereq.1: Ukutshintsha iiyunithi zexesha (iyure e-1 nemizuzu engama-30 ziyi-1.5 iiyure)
z-m-14-01.s.s1.prompt: Ngalo lonke ixesha kongezwa ulwazi, khetha ingcinga yakho malunga nesantya esiqhelekileyo sohambo lokuya nokubuya. Akufuneki utshintshe ingcinga yakho yokuqala. Gweba ngokwakho ukuba ubungqina bwanele na.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha umgama uze kuqala ufumane ukuba iindlela zokuya nokubuya zithatha iiyure ezingaphi nganye.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.hint.1: Funda ulwazi olutsha uthelekise enye enye apho lufana khona nahlukile khona kwingcinga oyikhethe kuqala.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Indlela yokuya i-60 km ngeyure kwaye indlela yokubuya i-40 km ngeyure. Awukawazi umgama weendlela enye okanye ixesha elithathiweyo.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ujonge olu lwazi kuphela, ucinga ukuba sisantya esiyintoni esiqhelekileyo sohambo lokuya nokubuya?
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Alukho ucala olugqitywe okwangoku. Ukukhetha umgama nokubala ngqo kuya kunceda isigwebo sakho.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kanye i-50 km ngeyure. Oku kungenxa yokuba iphakathi kwe-60 ne-40.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Le yingcinga ethatha ixabiso eliphakathi lezantya ezimbini njengomndilili. Unokuvavanya kamva xa le ngcinga isebenza khona.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kubonakala iya kuba ngaphantsi kwe-50 km ngeyure. Oku kungenxa yokuba ixesha lokuhamba ngesantya esicotha libonakala lide.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ucinge hayi nje ngezantya kodwa nangobude bexesha elichithwe ngesantya ngasinye.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kubonakala iya kuba ngaphezulu kwe-50 km ngeyure. Oku kungenxa yokuba bakhwela ngokukhawuleza ekuyeni.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ujonge icala elaya ngokukhawuleza kuphela. Kuya kuba kuhle ukujonga ukuba ixesha elithathe ukuhamba umgama ofanayo liyafana kwiimeko ezimbini.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Asiwazi umgama weendlela enye, ngoko asinakwazi nesantya esiqhelekileyo.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Le yingcinga efanele ukuvavanywa ngqo ukubona ukuba umgama uyafuneka ngokwenene na.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Masithi umgama weendlela enye yi-120 km. Indlela yokuya ithatha iiyure ezi-2 kwaye indlela yokubuya ithatha iiyure ezi-3. Oko kuthetha ukuba bahambe uhambo lokuya nokubuya lwe-240 km ngeeyure ezi-5 ewonke.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ubona esi siphumo sokubala, ucinga ntoni ngesantya esiqhelekileyo sohambo lokuya nokubuya?
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Xa umgama weendlela enye yi-120 km, asiyi-50 km ngeyure. Kuthekani ukuba umgama weendlela enye wahlukile?
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Sinokuthi yi-50 km ngeyure. Iphakathi kwe-60 ne-40, ngoko ihlala injalo.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Awuthelekisi ukuba isiphumo esibaliweyo nokuqikelela kokuqala kuyaphikisana. Thelekisa nexabiso lokuhamba i-240 km ngeeyure ezi-5.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Yi-48 km ngeyure. Bahambe i-240 km ngeeyure ezi-5, ngoko kunjengokuba bahambe i-48 km iyure nganye.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ujonge umndilili usebenzisa umgama opheleleyo nexesha elipheleleyo.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Xa umgama weendlela enye yi-120 km, yi-48 km ngeyure. Asikazi ukuba ixabiso liyatshintsha na ukuba umgama utshintsha.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Esi sisigwebo esinononophelo sokuba, nasemva kokufumana isiphumo setyala elinye, sifuna ukujonga ngokwahlukileyo ukuba siyafana na kwimigama eyahlukileyo.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Yi-52 km ngeyure. Bakhawuleza ekuyeni, ngoko likhulu kune-50.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ujonge amaxesha owabalileyo (iiyure ezi-2 nezi-3), icala elicotha lakhwelwa ixesha elide. Cinga ukuba loo nyani ibonakala njani kumndilili.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Ubale nangemigama yeendlela enye ye-60 km ne-300 km. 60 km: iyure e-1 ekuyeni neyure e-1 nemizuzu engama-30 ekubuyeni, ngoko bahambe uhambo lokuya nokubuya lwe-120 km ngeeyure ezi-2 nemizuzu engama-30. 300 km: iiyure ezi-5 ekuyeni neeyure ezi-7 nemizuzu engama-30 ekubuyeni, ngoko bahambe uhambo lokuya nokubuya lwe-600 km ngeeyure ezi-12 nemizuzu engama-30.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ujonge onke amatyala apho umgama weendlela enye yi-60 km, 120 km, kunye ne-300 km, ugweba njani?
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Kuyo yonke imigama emithathu evavanyiweyo, yi-48 km ngeyure. Kodwa oku akugqibi imigama engavavanywanga.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Yayi-48 km ngeyure kuwo onke amatyala amathathu. Kule migama mithathu, yayifana nokuba umgama utshintshile.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ushwankathele isiphumo ngoxa uchaza kanye uluhlu olwavavanywa.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Okukhona umgama mde, kokukhona isantya esiqhelekileyo sohambo lokuya nokubuya siba sikhulu.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Beka amaxabiso esantya esiqhelekileyo samatyala amathathu macala ngamacala uwathelekise.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Sizamile kathathu, ngoko sele kungqinwe ukuba yi-48 km ngeyure nakwimiphi imigama.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ugqibe onke amatyala ngemizekelo embalwa evavanyiweyo. Ukuba imizekelo embalwa ilunge kwahlukile kubungqina.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Umndilili wahlukile kumgama ngamnye, ngoko asinakuthi ngexabiso elinye.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Kubonakala ukuba oku ukuthethile ungaqhathanisanga iziphumo zamatyala amathathu. Jonga amanani kwakhona.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.info: Ngeli xesha, masigcine ixesha lifana endaweni yomgama. Ekuyeni bakhwela iiyure ezi-2 ngesantya se-60 km ngeyure, kwaye ekubuyeni bakhwela iiyure ezi-2 ngesantya se-40 km ngeyure. Imigama kumacala omabini isenokungabi lifana.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.ask: Sisiphi isantya esiqhelekileyo sohambo lokuya nokubuya kule meko?
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.after: Xa umgama wagcinwa ufana wayi-48 km ngeyure, kwaye xa ixesha lagcinwa lifana lalingu-50 km ngeyure. Umndilili uxhomekeke koko kugcinwe kufana.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Ingaphantsi kwe-50 km ngeyure. Yaphuma ingaphantsi kwe-50 km ngeyure ngaphambili, ngoko nangeli xesha.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Oko kwagcinwa kufana ngaphambili (umgama) noko kugcinwe kufana ngeli xesha (ixesha) kwahlukile, kodwa uthathele isiphumo njengoko sinjalo.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Asinakuxela. Oku kungenxa yokuba asiwazi umgama.

z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.o.c: Yi-50 km ngeyure. Oku kungenxa yokuba bahambe i-120 km kunye ne-80 km, i-200 km ewonke, ngeeyure ezi-4.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Ubale kwakhona phantsi kwale meko intsha (ixesha liyafana) ukujonga.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.o.d: Yi-48 km ngeyure. Yayi-48 km ngeyure ngaphambili, ngoko ifana nangeli xesha.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Uthathele isiphumo sangaphambili njengoko sinjalo kwimeko apho imeko itshintshile. Bala kwakhona phantsi kwemeko etshintshiweyo.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni i-50 km ngeyure ibonakala ikhona kakhulu, kodwa xa umgama wagcinwa ufana, yayi-48 km ngeyure. Yayi-50 km ngeyure kuphela xa ixesha lagcinwa lifana. Jonga ukuba lulwazi luphi olutshintshe isigwebo sakho, okanye ukuba aluzange lufune ukutshintsha.
z-m-14-01.s.s2.prompt: U-Hyewon uthe, "Isantya esiqhelekileyo sohambo lokuya nokubuya lixabiso eliphakathi lezantya ezimbini." Chaza, usebenzisa amanani owabonileyo ngasentla, kweyiphi imeko esi sibhengezo silunge kuyo nakweyiphi singalunganga.

z-m-14-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ugqithise ukuthi ixabiso eliphakathi lezantya ezimbini lihlala lingumndilili?

z-m-14-02.title: Ukwandisa ifoto ukuze ingene kwifreyimu kanye
z-m-14-02.topic: Ukwandisa ngomlinganiselo ofanayo kunye neemeko zoluhlu
z-m-14-02.goal: Xa wandisa ububanzi nobude befoto ngomlinganiselo ofanayo, yenza ubungakanani obuninzi obunokwenzeka ngaphakathi kwemeko yobungakanani befreyimu, uze ufumane obona bukhulu obunokungena.
z-m-14-02.material: U-Doyun ufuna ukushicilela ifoto ebanzi nge-12 cm kwaye ende nge-9 cm ibe nkulu ayifake kwifreyimu. Ukuze ifoto ingaphazamiseki, kufuneka andise ububanzi nobude ngomlinganiselo ofanayo. Ubungakanani bangaphakathi befreyimu apho ifoto ingena khona bubanzi nge-30 cm kwaye bude nge-21 cm. Yonke ifoto kufuneka ingene ngaphakathi kobungakanani bangaphakathi (ububanzi i-30 cm ubuninzi, ubude i-21 cm ubuninzi), kwaye ifoto kufuneka ibe nkulu kunangoku. Bhala ubude nge-cm, kwaye indawo enye yedesimali iyavunyelwa.
z-m-14-02.thinking.1: Ukwenza isisombululo esanelisa iimeko ezininzi (umlinganiselo noluhlu) ngaxeshanye
z-m-14-02.thinking.2: Ukuqaphela ukuba ukungena kwecala elinye kunokwenza elinye licime
z-m-14-02.s.s1.prompt: U-Doyun uthe, "Masiyandise ukuze ububanzi bube yi-30 cm kanye, kufana nobubanzi bangaphakathi." Ukuba senza oko, ifoto iya kungena kwifreyimu?
z-m-14-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kuqala fumana ukuba i-12 cm kufuneka ibe nkulu kangakanani ukuze ibe yi-30 cm.
z-m-14-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ukuba ubude butshintsha ngala maxesha nawo, fumana ukuba ubude buba ngama-cm amangaphi uze uthelekise nobude bangaphakathi be-21 cm.
z-m-14-02.s.s1.o.a: Iyangena. Ububanzi bufana nobubanzi bangaphakathi be-30 cm, ngoko yonke ifoto iyangena.
z-m-14-02.s.s1.r.a: Ucinge ukuba kwanele ukungenisa ububanzi kuphela. Awujongi ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kubude.

z-m-14-04.material: Intsapho ka-Minseo ikhetha enye yeendlela ezimbini kwipaki yokuzonwabisa. z-m-14-05.title: Ukudibanisa iikwere ze-10 ezenziwe ngezinti zomlilo

z-m-14-05.s.s1.prompt: U-Seoyun wafumana inani lezinti zomlilo ezifunekayo ukudibanisa iikwere ezi-10 njengoko kubonisiwe ngezantsi. Khetha umgca wokuqala ongalunganga.

z-m-14-05.s.s2.r.f: Ulivezile ngokwenza ikwere yokuqala ibe yi-1 kuqala wongeza i-3 kwezo zisaleyo.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.explain: Ikwere e-1 ithatha izinti zomlilo ezi-4, kwaye ngalo lonke ixesha udibanisa enye, inyuka nge-3. Ngoko 4+3×(□−1), 4×□−(□−1), kunye ne-3×□+1 zonke ngumthetho ofanayo. Unokujonga ngokufaka iikwere ezi-1, 2, nezi-3 ubone ukuba ufumana i-4, 7, ne-10.

z-m-14-10.title: Ukuba unamathelisa iibhokisi ezi-2, kwenzeka ntoni kwindawo yomphezulu?
z-m-14-10.topic: Indawo yomphezulu yomzimba oqulathe imilo edityanisiweyo
z-m-14-10.goal: Fumana impazamo kwisisombululo esithi "yongeza nje iindawo zomphezulu zenye nenye" xa ufumana indawo yomphezulu womzimba owenziwe ngokudibanisa iikhyuboyidi ezi-2, uze ugwebe imeko apho indawo yokudibanisa ichaphazela indawo yomphezulu.
z-m-14-10.material: Beka ikhyuboyidi encinci B (ibanzi ngo-4 cm, inde ngo-6 cm, iphakame ngo-3 cm) phezu kobuso obungaphezulu bekhyuboyidi enkulu A (ibanzi ngo-10 cm, inde ngo-6 cm, iphakame ngo-4 cm) uze uzinamathelise wenze umzimba o-1. Ingaphantsi lonke lika-B (ibanzi ngo-4 cm, inde ngo-6 cm) lichukumisa ubuso obungaphezulu buka-A, yaye ubude buka-B obungu-6 cm bufana nobude buka-A obungu-6 cm, ngoko ubuso bangaphambili nabangasemva buyalingana. Ufuna ukuzoba yonke imiphezulu ebonakala ngaphandle koo mzimba (kuquka ubuso obungaphantsi). "Indawo yomphezulu" sisixa sendawo yayo yonke imiphezulu ebonakala ngaphandle.
z-m-14-10.thinking.1: Ukugweba ukuba indlela (indawo) yokudibanisa itshintsha isiphumo na
z-m-14-10.thinking.2: Ukuqiqa ukuba isigqibo sitshintsha njani xa imiqathango itshintsha
z-m-14-10.s.s1.prompt: USeohyeon wafumana indawo yomphezulu ngolu hlobo. Khetha umgca o-1 ophosisiweyo.
z-m-14-10.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana ukuba ngawaphi amacala angasabonakali ngaphandle xa u-A no-B bedityaniswa.
z-m-14-10.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuba ingaba indawo yamacala angabonakaliyo iquka kuzo zombini i-248 ne-108.
z-m-14-10.s.s1.line.2: Indawo yomphezulu womzimba odityanisiweyo yindawo yomphezulu ka-A no-B edityanisiweyo: 248+108=356 cm².
z-m-14-10.s.s1.explain: Umgca o-3 uphosisiwe. Icandelo apho ubuso obungaphezulu buka-A nobuso obungaphantsi buka-B bukwichukumisana (4×6=24 cm²) alinakubonwa ngaphandle emva kokudibanisa. z-m-14-10.s.s2.prompt: U-B unokunamathiselwa naphi na ukuba nje ingaphantsi lonke luka-B lichukumisa ngaphakathi kobuso obungaphezulu buka-A. UMingi unamathisele u-B esiphelweni sasekhohlo sobuso obungaphezulu buka-A, yaye uHayun wanamathisela malunga nembindi (kuzo zombini, ubude buka-B bufana nobude buka-A). Indawo yomphezulu yemizimba emibini ithelekiswa njani?
z-m-14-10.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana indawo echukumisanayo kwimizimba emibini nganye.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ukuba indawo ethinteneyo ifanayo, indawo efihlakeleyo ifana nayo na.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.o.a: Eka-Mingi incinci. Kungenxa yokuba ekupheleni kwasekhohlo ubuso buyalingana, ngoko kugqitha ngakumbi.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.r.a: Uthathe ubuso obubonakala bungaphazamiseki kumphezulu ofanayo njengobufana nobuso obufihlakeleyo. Nokuba buyalingana, indawo ebonakalayo ayincipheki.

z-m-14-09.goal: Usebenzisa izikwere ezigqunywe ngokupheleleyo sisetyhula kwigridi nezo zigqunywe ngokuyinxalenye, chaza uluhlu apho indawo yesetyhula ilele khona, uze uhlole uqikelelo lwakho ngokubona ukuba uluhlu lutshintsha njani xa izikwere zenziwa zincinci.
z-m-14-09.material: Isetyhula esinerediyasi ye-5 cm sizotyiwe kwiphepha legridi apho isikwere ngasinye sibanzi ngo-1 cm size sibe nde ngo-1 cm (indawo ye-1 cm²). Embindini wesetyhula usencopheni e-1 yegridi. Zikho izikwere ezingama-60 ezingaphakathi ngokupheleleyo kwisetyhula, yaye kuquka izikwere apho umgca wesetyhula uthi udlule khona, zikho izikwere ezingama-88 ngokubanzi ezingaphakathi ngokuyinxalenye ubuncinane.
